In this Business English course, you will learn the essential vocabulary, phrases, and skills needed to excel in the workplace. 

This course is designed to make you feel confident and professional whether you are preparing for meetings, presentations, or just want to feel more at ease using English in business contexts. 

Business English Focus

- Advertising and Marketing: Explore terms and techniques used in marketing, branding, and customer engagement, essential for business professionals.

- Business Email Writing: Get hands-on practice with writing professional emails that are polite, effective, and to-the-point.

Each lesson is designed to be engaging and interactive. You will work through PDFs, audio clips, and video materials to practice speaking, listening, writing, and vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.description:
Unlock the language of law with our engaging Legal English course, specifically designed for lawyers, law students, and legal professionals at the intermediate level. This course is tailored to help you confidently communicate in English within the fields of American and British Common Law.

In this course you will build essential vocabulary and understanding of legal concepts. We cover areas such as contracts, criminal law, and intellectual property. Each lesson is carefully designed and structured to introduce you to legal terminology and communication whether you are preparing for work with international clients and colleagues or simply want to refine your Legal English. 

Course Focus:

Speaking and Conversation: Through real-world scenarios and lively discussions, you will develop fluency and confidence in discussing legal topics. We will focus on role-playing common legal interactions, client consultations, debates and mock court arguments to make learning interactive and practical.
  
- Grammar and Listening Practice: Learn the structures and forms most common in legal writing and speaking. We’ll work on mastering grammar to ensure clarity and precision, which are critical in legal language.
  
- Legal Writing Instruction and Practice: For those interested in refining their Legal English writing skills, we will offer guidance on drafting contracts, legal opinions, and formal emails. You’ll learn how to convey complex ideas with accuracy and professionalism.

Why This Course?

This course not only improves your Legal English but also sharpens your critical thinking and persuasive speaking. Together, we’ll explore contemporary cases and topics that bring excitement to each session. Join us to expand your English skills and deepen your knowledge of the legal world. Get ready for a challenging, fun, and rewarding learning experience! 

Let’s start speaking Legal English confidently—book your first lesson today!

Then, I will ask you a few questions about the company and the specific role you are applying for.  Then we'll discuss potential interview questions based on your industry and role.  I'll work with you to ensure you have strong answers as well as examples from your past experience to help you answer the most common interview questions.  

I'll make sure that you're comfortable explaining your answers in English and that you are delivering them in a clear and concise manner.

I'll also coach you on proper interviewing etiquette, including before, during and after the interview. My goal is to make sure you feel comfortable and confident before your interview.  

I was a hiring manager for three years and have interviewed hundreds of potential candidates in the past, so I know what types of questions companies and hiring managers like to ask and how to best answer these questions.

We can also discuss salary negotiations and job expectations.

You will feel more confident and prepared for your interview after this session.

We’ll build on what you’ve learned, providing a supportive, judgment-free environment where you can speak as much as possible. pro_course_detail.description:
Cambridge KET Exam Preparation  

This course is designed to fully prepare your child for the Cambridge KET exam, ensuring they build a strong foundation in English. I use the Complete KET Student’s Book and Workbook to cover all essential grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills. Throughout the course, we will also incorporate practice tests to track progress and determine when your child is test-ready. If additional support is needed, we will use the Exam Booster for extra exam-style practice.  

The time required to prepare for KET depends on your child’s current level. It can take up to a year or more to fully develop the necessary skills to excel in the exam. My goal is not just to help them pass but to ensure they build a solid foundation for future exams like PET and FCE.  

Many students pass KET and PET based on their speaking ability alone, without mastering grammar. However, when they reach FCE, they struggle due to gaps in their grammar knowledge. That is why I emphasize a balanced approach, making sure your child is exposed to all key language areas so they can progress confidently through the Cambridge levels.  

By focusing on strong grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills in KET, your child will be well-prepared for future challenges. Investing in their foundation now will make their English journey smoother, and their future self will thank you.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
I believe in keeping things simple and using clear, straightforward language to help you achieve your desired band score. Many people assume that using advanced vocabulary is necessary for a high score. While that can be true to some extent, if you are not able to use advanced words correctly, it may lower your score. That is why I focus on essential linking words that can effectively improve your performance.  

In our lessons, we will explore conditional sentences with "if" to discuss possible situations, helping you express ideas with confidence. We will also work on expanding your vocabulary with words like "more," which indicate an increase in quantity or degree, enriching your writing without making it too complex.  

A key part of our sessions will be learning how to connect and extend ideas smoothly. I will show you how to use "and" and "also" to add information naturally, and how to emphasize important points with "not only... but also." We will practice using "to" and "the" for clarity and specificity, and I will explain how "which" can be used to add extra details about a noun, making your sentences clearer and more precise.  

I will encourage you to reflect on your progress, helping you think carefully about what you have learned and how to apply it effectively. We will also work on cause and effect by using "because" to explain reasons, "therefore" to show logical conclusions, and "so" to indicate results, allowing you to create well-structured arguments.  

Finally, I will guide you in using "when" to refer to specific situations and teach you how to introduce contrasting ideas with "but" or "however." With this approach, you will not only prepare effectively for your exams but also develop a strong foundation in English.  

Together, we will work towards your success.
